newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Ex-Im bank to lend 5.0 bln yen to Hungary.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Ex-Im bank to lend 5.0 bln yen to Hungary.

text.p: The Export-Import Bank of Japan said on Friday that it would provide a five billion yen loan to Hungary.

The bank said in a statement that the loan would be used as an export credit facility for the Hungarian Export-Import Bank with the purpose of recovering trade between Hungary and the former Soviet Union and eastern European nations.
The loan is also designed to promote exports of high value-added machinery and equipment which will create more sophisticated industries in those countries, it said.
Japan's Ex-Im bank said it has actively supported the export promotion measures of the Hungarian government.
